About this prototype

When the local model service is connected, Gemini chooses the NPC response. Otherwise, the page identifies itself as an offline demo.The NPC situation is set at the start. Your interpretation is excluded from his decisions.The encounter ends when contact is mutually acknowledged or someone leaves. Both perspectives are then shown for every moment.Refreshing clears the current ride.
